1.content:
## Dynatrace Assist — Operator Utilization & Cost
Monitor usage of Dynatrace Assist in **operator mode** — the conversational AI agent that plans and executes DQL queries on your behalf. Only operator skill sessions are included; other skills and external MCP clients are excluded.

**Data sources:** `GENAI_EVENT` records every prompt and AI response. `QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT` (client: `dt.mcp.gateway`) records every DQL query Assist executes, including bytes scanned and billed. Zero-scan calls (metrics, topology lookups) are excluded from cost tiles.

10.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation"
| filter skill == "chat"
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| summarize queries = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
| sort queries desc
| limit 20
10.title: Top Users by Prompts Sent

11.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| summarize bytes_gb = sum(scanned_bytes) / 1000000000, by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
| sort bytes_gb desc
| limit 20
11.title: Top Users by Billed Bytes (GB)

12.content:
### Cost Attribution & Breakdown
- **Bytes by data type (center):** Where scanning cost comes from. Logs dominate because they are verbose; metrics and topology are free and not shown here.
- **User cost table (right):** Per-user breakdown split by log · span · event bytes. Use this for internal cost allocation or to identify who would benefit most from query guidance.

14.query:

14.title: Billed Bytes by Data Type

15.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| fieldsAdd log_bytes = if(table == "logs", scanned_bytes, else: 0), span_bytes = if(table == "spans", scanned_bytes, else: 0), event_bytes = if(table == "events", scanned_bytes, else: 0)
| summarize total_queries = countDistinct(query_id), total_bytes_gb = sum(scanned_bytes) / 1000000000, log_bytes_gb = sum(log_bytes) / 1000000000, span_bytes_gb = sum(span_bytes) / 1000000000, event_bytes_gb = sum(event_bytes) / 1000000000, by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
| sort total_bytes_gb desc
| limit 30
15.title: User Cost & Activity Summary

17.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation" and skill == "chat"
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| lookup [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation" and skill == "chat"
    | filter isNotNull(topic) and topic != ""
    | sort timestamp asc
    | summarize first_topic = takeFirst(topic), by: {conversation_id}
  ], sourceField: conversation_id, lookupField: conversation_id
| summarize turns = count(), topic = takeFirst(lookup.first_topic), user = takeFirst(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))), first_prompt = takeFirst(user_input), started = min(timestamp), by: {conversation_id}
| sort started desc
| limit 100
17.title: Conversation Sessions (Operator Skill)

18.content: Full conversation log for Assist operator sessions — every prompt and AI response in chronological order, newest first. Use this to understand what users are asking and how Assist responded. Filter by user above to focus on a specific person.

19.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation" and skill == "chat"
| filter isNotNull(user_input)
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| lookup [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation" and skill == "chat"
    | filter isNotNull(topic) and topic != ""
    | sort timestamp asc
    | summarize first_topic = takeFirst(topic), by: {conversation_id}
  ], sourceField: conversation_id, lookupField: conversation_id
| fieldsAdd effective_topic = coalesce(topic, lookup.first_topic)
| fields timestamp, user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), skill, topic = effective_topic, user_input, response
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 100
19.title: Recent Conversations (Operator Skill)

20.content:
### Top DQL Queries by Billed Bytes
Individual queries executed by Assist sorted by data scanned. Use this to spot expensive patterns: unbounded time ranges, missing `scanLimitGBytes`, or repeated broad scans that could be narrowed with better prompting or DQL education.

21.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| fieldsRename data_type = table
| summarize billed_gb = toDouble(sum(scanned_bytes)) / 1000000000, user = takeFirst(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))), data_type = takeFirst(data_type), timestamp = min(timestamp), query_string = takeFirst(query_string), status = takeFirst(status), duration_ms = max(execution_duration_ms), by: {query_id}
| sort billed_gb desc
| limit 100
21.title: Costliest Queries Executed via Assist

22.content: Each row is a unique conversation with Assist, showing the opening question, how many back-and-forth turns it lasted, and the auto-classified topic where available. Long multi-turn conversations indicate high engagement — short ones may signal users who didn't get the answer they needed.

24.content: Flags usage outliers using two complementary views: **Scan Limit Overrides (left)** — users who explicitly set `scanLimitGBytes`, including `-1` (unlimited, removes all cost protection). **Query Cost Scatter (right)** — every user plotted by query volume (X) vs. avg GB/query (Y). Bottom-right = efficient power users (many cheap queries). Top-right = true outliers (many expensive queries). The table below ranks all users by total billed GB and shows how many times the population average they are.

25.query:
fetch dt.system.events, from: now() - 30d
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter contains(query_string, "scanLimitGBytes", caseSensitive: false)
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events, from: now() - 30d | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| fieldsAdd has_unlimited = contains(lower(query_string), "scanlimitgbytes:-1") or contains(lower(query_string), "scanlimitgbytes: -1")
| summarize override_queries = countDistinct(query_id), unlimited_queries = countDistinct(if(has_unlimited == true, query_id, else: null)), total_gb = toDouble(sum(scanned_bytes)) / 1000000000, by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
| sort total_gb desc
| limit 50
25.title: Scan Limit Overrides (users modifying scanLimitGBytes)

26.description: ↙ few queries · low cost = light users   ↘ many queries · low cost = efficient power users ✓   ↖ few queries · high cost = one-off expensive (investigate)   ↗ many queries · high cost = systematic overuse ⚠️
26.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| summarize total_bytes = sum(scanned_bytes), query_count = countDistinct(query_id), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}

| fields user, query_count, avg_gb_per_query
26.title: Query Cost Scatter: Volume vs. Avg GB per Query

30.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| summarize total_bytes = sum(scanned_bytes), query_count = countDistinct(query_id), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
| fieldsAdd total_gb = toDouble(total_bytes) / 1000000000, avg_gb_per_query = toDouble(total_bytes) / 1000000000 / query_count, _key = "all"
| lookup [
    fetch dt.system.events
    | filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
    | filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
    | fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
    | lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
    | filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
    | summarize total_bytes_per_user = sum(scanned_bytes), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}
    | summarize mean_gb = avg(toDouble(total_bytes_per_user) / 1000000000)
    | fieldsAdd _key = "all"
  ], sourceField: _key, lookupField: _key
| fieldsAdd times_over_avg = round(total_gb / lookup.mean_gb, decimals: 1)
| fields user, query_count, total_gb, avg_gb_per_query, times_over_avg
| sort total_gb desc
| limit 20
30.title: Users by Total Billed GB — Times Over Average

6.content:
### Usage Trends
- **Prompts & unique users (left):** Daily Assist activity. Prompts = total interactions; unique users = distinct people active that day. Rising prompts with flat unique users means the same people are engaging more; rising unique users means adoption is spreading.
- **Billed bytes (right):** Cost trend by data source. Log scanning typically dominates. A sudden spike usually means a user ran an unbounded query without a time range or scan limit.

7.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and event.type == "GenAI Skill Invocation" and skill == "chat"
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| makeTimeseries prompts = count(), unique_users = countDistinct(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)))
7.title: Prompts & Unique Users Per Day

8.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT" and client.internal_service_context == "dt.mcp.gateway"
| filter scanned_bytes > 0
| filter not (table == "events" and (contains(query_string, "dt.davis.problems", caseSensitive: false) or contains(query_string, "dt.davis.events", caseSensitive: false)))
| filter in(lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email)), array($UserFilter))
| fieldsAdd user_key = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))
| lookup [fetch dt.system.events | filter event.kind == "GENAI_EVENT" and skill == "chat" | summarize op_count = count(), by: {user = lower(coalesce(user.email, user_email))}], sourceField: user_key, lookupField: user
| filter isNotNull(lookup.op_count)
| fieldsRename data_type = table
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(scanned_bytes), by: {data_type}
8.title: Billed Bytes Over Time by Data Type

9.content:
### Most Active Users
- **By prompts (left):** Engagement ranking — high counts reflect productive or exploratory users. Compare with the bytes chart: a user with many prompts but low bytes is asking frequent cheap questions; a user with few prompts but high bytes is running broad, expensive scans.
- **By billed bytes (right):** Cost attribution — the primary view for quota planning and chargeback conversations.
